channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

item.title: Mortal remains of two Keralam residents killed in Germany fire brought home
item.description: Body of the third victim is expected to be brought home on Friday night

item.title: Karnataka SIR: Teaching on the back burner
item.description: Children in government and aided schools across Karnataka have not seen several of their teachers for months, for most of them have been assigned as Booth Level Officers for the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Students tell Rishita Khanna that what initially seemed like fun with many free hours, is now making them anxious...

item.title: How did 37 people declare themselves dead in Karnataka’s voter rolls?
item.description: At least 37 people have reportedly filed forms seeking the deletion of their own names from Karnataka’s electoral rolls on the ground that they were “dead”.

item.title: Trying to establish 'facts' about incident 'apparently' involving Indians on yacht off Yemen coast: India
item.description: The incident comes amid an escalation of hostilities between Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi Arabia, with both sides targeting each other's facilities and infrastructure

item.title: A greying population, a strained care system
item.description: Gaps in geriatric healthcare and support systems leave many older people struggling to access medical care, find reliable caregivers, and cope with mental health concerns and social isolation. These challenges threaten their independence and quality of life, particularly among those from economically weaker backgrounds. With Telangana’s population aged 60 and above projected to grow over the next decade, the shortcomings in healthcare, mental health support and community services need urgent attention, finds K. Shiva Shanker

item.title: Karnataka to set up committee to boost deceased donor organ transplants
item.description: Panel will recommend measures to strengthen organ donation network, says Health Minister

item.title: SAT Hospital in Keralam rejects charges of ‘clinical trial drugs’ given to SMA-afflicted children
item.description: Hospital Superintendent says decision to provide SMA patients with a less expensive, generic version of the original molecule against SMA, in place of the imported original drug costing several lakhs of rupees for a single vial, was taken by a technical committee comprising experts in the field

item.title: Good-quality diets associated with better cholesterol levels even among those with genetic load
item.description: Chennai-based study reveals the essential link between the quality of diet and cholesterol levels in Asian Indians

item.title: Administrative chaos grips Rajampet Lok Sabha constituency after district reorganisation
item.description: At present, Rajampet has four Collectors, four SPs, four different political ecosystems, and remains a seat that everyone claims but no district currently owns; officials claim the 2022 decision to carve the districts along parliamentary-constituency lines has backfired in Rajampet’s case

item.title: Why are Andhra Pradesh’s civic poll nominations under the Supreme Court’s scrutiny? | Explained
item.description: The Supreme Court has asked the State Election Commission to decide where candidates were unable to file nominations

item.title: Parvinder Singh Jhota: Who was the anti-drug activist, why was he killed
item.description: Known for raising his voice against the illegal sale of addictive substances at chemist shops, Jhota was shot in broad daylight inside a medical store at a busy marketplace in Punjab’s Mansa

item.title: CM Satheesan offers to host Raihan Vadra's exhibition in Keralam
item.description: Raihan Vadra said the Bikaner House administration in Delhi pulled down many of his pictures of the protests at his solo exhibition, 'No Idea Is Final'

item.title: POCSO survivor cannot be denied compensation solely due to absence of injury marks: Allahabad HC
item.description: The case relates to an FIR registered at Sarojini Nagar police station in Lucknow on December 7, 2022. A chargesheet in this connection was filed on January 13, 2023.

item.title: Bihar MLC polls begin for 8 seats, 150 candidates in fray
item.description: The combined electorate stands at 5,32,847, including 1,46,611 women and 37 third-gender voters, across 933 polling stations

item.title: What are the powers and functions of Special Executive Magistrates? | Explained
item.description: State governments appoint Special Executive Magistrates for specific areas or purposes and give them the powers exercised by the Executive Magistrates under the BNSS, 2023

item.title: What does eMudhra’s web security key leak mean for internet users? | Explained
item.description: The exposure of eMudhra’s private keys could allow for man-in-the-middle attacks if left unpatched on all devices

item.title: ‘Game boards’ carved on rocks in Kasaragod hint at age-old yen for leisure
item.description: Six such ‘games,’ resembling the Manjadippala or Kadippala boards, were found carved on rocks, hinting that people engaged in recreational activities thousands of years ago. However, doubts have been raised about their antiquity and purpose. Further studies and scientific dating are required to determine their precise age

item.title: How India thwarted Pakistan’s bid to steal crucial defence data
item.description: Officers of the Counter Intelligence Cell of Andhra Pradesh, intrigued by a slew of messaging patterns across various social media platforms, busted a major digital honey-trap racket, including the Indian conduits, whose motive was to leak sensitive defence details, specifically Naval intelligence, to the neighbouring country’s Inter-Services Intelligence, writes Sumit Bhattacharjee

item.title: When mob takes law into its own hands: another man lynched in Keralam’s Palakkad
item.description: The brutal lynching of an aurally challenged, unidentified man near the Moolathara dam in Keralam’s Palakkad has once again shaken the conscience of society. Abdul Latheef Naha speaks to investigators, psychiatrists and forensic experts to understand how did a homeless man become the target of a group that took it upon itself to punish him and such incidents are recurring.

item.title: Cabinet Secretary had copied acknowledgement sent to letters by two ECs to CEC for ‘information’: RTI reply
item.description: Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi wrote to Cabinet Secretary T.V. Somanathan on July 29 regarding the working of Senior Deputy Election Commissioner Maneesh Garg

item.title: Indian killed as Houthis attack Saudi Arabia’s Dammam airport
item.description: Separately, the Houthis (Ansar Allah) claimed that Saudi Arabia had attacked a yacht carrying Indians in the Red Sea, adding that they were conducting rescue operations

item.title: Face-off with China continues at multiple locations along Arunachal border: ITBP D-G
item.description: ITBP chief says drones are the future of warfare, warning that India cannot face China with traditional weapons alone; says underground shelters are a priority in the new style of border warfare

item.title: The grandmothers hitting patriarchy and weights
item.description: Grandmothers in areas surrounding Delhi are rewriting the rules of engagement, one reel at a time. From challenging patriarchy and lifting weights to dancing to Haryanvi pop and inspiring other seniors to embrace fitness, they are turning social media into a platform for self-expression, defiance, and a new-found freedom, finds Ashok Kumar

item.title: An ironclad resolve in the national interest
item.description: Home Minister Amit Shah’s decision-making ability, commitment to national security, and role as one of the architects of modern India’s development will ensure that his name occupies a prominent place in the country’s political history

item.title: SEBI cautions investors against fraudulent stock-tip WhatsApp groups
item.description: “To make these calls look credible, certain members, acting in concert with the operators, post false claims of profit and praise the 'expert'. This practice, known as astroturfing, creates a false impression of genuine support and induces unsuspecting investors to act on the call,” says SEBI
